arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Luthey argued Congress exempted tribes from federal wagering taxes.
Mr. Dumont defended the statute's application to tribal gaming.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the argument by submitting the case.
